metrics.name: vulnerability_exploitation_growth_yoy
metrics.notes: The exploitation of vulnerabilities as an initial access step in breaches grew by 180% year-over-year.

metrics.name: pretexting_in_social_breaches
metrics.notes: Pretexting, including Business Email Compromise (BEC), was involved in 29% of all social engineering breaches.

metrics.name: median_time_to_click_phish_seconds
metrics.notes: The median time for a user to click a malicious link in a phishing campaign is less than 60 seconds.

insights: The human element continues to be a dominant factor in breaches, with social engineering and misuse being frequent attack patterns.

metrics.name: data_compromises_2023
metrics.notes: Number of publicly reported data compromises in 2023, a 78% increase over 2022.

metrics.name: victims_impacted_2023
metrics.notes: Total number of estimated victims from data compromises in 2023.

insights: Supply chain attacks were a primary driver of the record-breaking number of compromises, impacting thousands of entities through a single point of failure.
